deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a handwritten list of mathematical (and some physical and classical) books, each with a price in Thaler (written with the Prussian Thaler sign, transcribed here as 'f') and Silbergroschen (Sgr, S). The numbers in front ('p. 1', 'p. 2', ... 'p. 23') are page references, almost certainly to a bookseller's or antiquarian catalogue arranged alphabetically within sections. The list is headed 'Riemann 20', which is probably an archival or bundle label rather than a title.

Titles that can be identified:
- d'Alembert, Traité de l'équilibre et du mouvement des fluides.
- Jakob Bernoulli, Ars conjectandi.
- Bouniakowsky, a memoir on divisors.
- Brennecke.
- Crelle's Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik, vols. 1-35, at 100 Th.
- Euler: Theoria motus corporum solidorum seu rigidorum; Opuscula analytica; Institutiones calculi integralis; Opuscula varii argumenti.
- Hero of Alexandria, Definitiones geometricae.
- Legendre, Théorie des nombres (Paris 1830).
- Commercium philosophicum et mathematicum of Leibniz and Johann Bernoulli.
- H. Lotze, De summis continuorum (Lotze's 1840 Leipzig dissertation).
- Monge, Application de l'analyse à la géométrie.
- Newton, Arithmetica universalis.
- Repertorium commentationum (Reuss).
- Steiner, Über den Krümmungs-Schwerpunkt (ebener Curven).
- Chebyshev (Tchébychew), Mémoire sur les nombres premiers (1852).
- Apollonius, De tactionibus (a restoration).
- Carnot, Geometrie der Stellung (struck out).
- Dilling, De graecis mathematicis.
- A. Dupré, Examen d'une proposition de Legendre relative à la théorie des nombres (1859).
- Einleitung in die Geometrie oder Entwicklung des Begriffs Raum.
- N. Fuss, Lobrede auf L. Euler.
- Klügel, Mathematisches Wörterbuch.
- J. H. Lambert, Beiträge zum Gebrauche der Mathematik; Zusätze zu den logarithmischen und trigonometrischen Tabellen.
- Mascheroni, Gebrauch des Zirkels (German translation of Geometria del compasso).
- Minding, Anfangsgründe der höheren Arithmetik.
- A number-theory primer 'Elemente der Zahlentheorie' (author uncertain).
- J. A. Serret, Cours d'algèbre supérieure.
- Steiner, Die geometrischen Constructionen, ausgeführt mittels der geraden Linie und eines festen Kreises.
- Aratus, Phaenomena.
- Gehler, Physikalisches Wörterbuch, at 30 Th.

Marginal figures ('12 f' beside the Euler group, '28 f 4' beside Lotze) look like running subtotals. My own check: the four Euler items sum to 17 Th 25 Sgr (2-20 + 5-10 + 6-10 + 3-15, with 30 Sgr = 1 Th). That does not equal the '12 f' beside them, so the margin figure refers to some other grouping or calculation.

Dating: the Dupré memoir (1859) gives a terminus post quem of 1859, if correctly identified. Chebyshev's memoir (1852) and Serret's Cours are consistent with this. The list is therefore late, from Riemann's Göttingen period or after.

Purpose: it may be a list of books Riemann wanted to buy, perhaps for himself or for the Göttingen library. Alternatively it could be a list connected with the disposal of his library after 1866, which the label 'Riemann 20' might suggest; it is not certain the hand is Riemann's.

The page has no connection to the ellipsoid (rotating fluid mass) computations on the neighbouring folios.
errors: No mathematical content, so no mathematical errors. The marginal subtotal '12 f' beside the Euler group does not match the sum of the listed Euler prices (17 Th 25 Sgr). Its referent is unclear.

results.what: Priced list of mathematical books with catalogue page numbers (bibliographic/purchase note)

deep.surprise_reason: A book or price list with no mathematical content. Of mild interest only for Riemann's reading or library history: number theory (Legendre, Chebyshev, Dupré, Minding, Bouniakowsky), Euler, and Steiner's geometry.

checkable.asserts: The four Euler items (2Th20, 5Th10, 6Th10, 3Th15) total 17 Th 25 Sgr, with 30 Sgr = 1 Thaler.

transcription_corrections: 'Lobrede auf L. Euler' is by Nicolaus Fuss (Fuß). The '7 1/2' written just above belongs to this line as its price.
'12 1/2' near the end probably belongs to 'Arati phaenomena' (p. 21), not to the Steiner line.
'Gehler[?] physikal. Wörterbuch': Gehler is correct (J. S. T. Gehler, Physikalisches Wörterbuch).
'Steiner, über den Krümmungsschwerpunkt[?]': the reading is plausible and matches Steiner's 1838 Crelle paper 'Über den Krümmungs-Schwerpunkt ebener Curven'.
'Steiner die geometrischen Konstruktionen' refers to Steiner's 1833 'Die geometrischen Constructionen ausgeführt mittelst der geraden Linie und eines festen Kreises'.
The second line ('Aufgaben aus Lehrbuch reiner Math cc') is very uncertain in the image; the first word may be 'Anfangsgründe'. Treat it as unread.
'Z. Schwarz Elemente d. Zahlentheorie': the author's initial and name are uncertain in the image.
'Leibnitii & Bernoullii comm. philos. & math.' = Commercium philosophicum et mathematicum of Leibniz and Johann Bernoulli. The word 'philos.' is partly overwritten.
Prices without a unit after Bouniakowsky (15), Dilling (6), Dupré (18), Einleitung (5) and Minding (20) are in Silbergroschen.
